visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A high-ceilinged hall displays a massive wall projection of the Little Prince character sitting atop a jagged mountain peak against a blue sky with puffy white clouds. A crowd of people is sitting on the dark floor in the foreground, watching the display in a dimly lit environment. (2) The visual transitions to a dark floor where white, glowing outlines of sheep are projected, moving slowly across the surface. (3) Vibrant, multi-layered projections fill the entire wall space, showing the Little Prince lying in a cosmic field of stars and purple-toned nebulae. A person's silhouette is visible as they walk past the projection. (4) The screen displays planetary scenes with a king on his throne and a businessman at a desk surrounded by high stacks of gold coins; a young child walks across the floor covered in circular coin projections. (5) A wide shot from a balcony viewpoint reveals the immense scale of the hall, with full-wall projections and hundreds of people sitting or walking through the immersive light environment. (6) The scene shifts to a retail gift shop featuring wooden shelving stocked with Le Petit Prince merchandise including books, mugs, and stationery. Browsing customers move through the background. (7) A close-up shot shows a hand lifting a small plush fox toy from a basket. The final frame features the plush fox sitting on a white table next to a large maroon leather handbag.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The track opens with a deep, resonating French male narration layered over a gentle, slow-tempo orchestral piano melody. Faint background crowd murmurs provide a sense of place. (2) A female Mandarin speaker enters with a calm and friendly tone, introducing the exhibition. The piano BGM continues, joined by soft string textures. A synthesized 'whoosh' effect highlights a visual scene change. (3) As the visuals become more cosmic, high-pitched 'sparkle' SFX and subtle 'ting' sounds are heard. The background French narration remains audible as a textural layer under the primary Mandarin voice. (4) The acoustic space shifts slightly to include more localized room tone and the faint rustling of paper or merchandise. The BGM maintains a steady, emotive pace. (5) The primary narration concludes with a warm, rising pitch, and the music swells briefly before fading into a clean, studio-processed silence.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Introduction -> Immersive Experience -> Practical Advice -> Conclusion/Shopping
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To document and recommend an immersive Little Prince exhibition, providing viewers with highlights of the visual experience and practical advice on how to enjoy the venue.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively combines immersive visual projections with a first-person narrative to create a recommendation vlog. The transition from the massive hall to the intimate gift shop provides a complete customer journey.
